problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package 1: weight 34kg
* Package 2: weight 57kg
* Package 3: weight 64kg
* Package 4: weight 65kg
* Package 5: weight 38kg
* Package 6: weight 40kg
* Package 7: weight 39kg
* Package 8: weight 43kg
* Package 9: weight 40kg
* Package 10: weight 44kg
* Package 11: weight 31kg
* Package 12: weight 63kg
* Package 13: weight 38kg
* Package 14: weight 61kg
* Package 15: weight 52kg
* Package 16: weight 69kg
* Package 17: weight 48kg
* Package 18: weight 51kg
* Package 19: weight 37kg
* Package 20: weight 56kg
* Package 21: weight 46kg

Each truck has a maximum load capacity of 100 kg. Assign all packages to trucks using the minimum number of trucks possible. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
